title: 1981 Black Sea exercise sighting, cameras seized and secrecy pledges signed
summary: Russian Republic tells of 1981 Black Sea exercise sighting, cameras seized and secrecy pledges signed, about 1981 at Black Sea, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: During the exercises on the Black Sea, several dozen unidentified craft flew in directly. People even photographed them with simple cameras. This was in 1981.

plain: The president of a Russian republic, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that in 1981, during military exercises on the Black Sea, several dozen unidentified craft flew right into the area, and people photographed them with ordinary cameras. According to the story, the cameras were then taken away and the witnesses had to sign pledges to keep it secret. If true, it would mean the Soviet military saw such craft and hid it.
